title.en: Sam Altman’s AI math avalanche lost three papers. Who checks the rest?
title.zh: 奥特曼的AI数学洪流撤回3篇：剩下719篇，谁来验？

summary.en: OpenAI’s October 7 revision log withdraws three related manuscripts after a sign error. Its current catalogue lists 719 manuscripts; public corrections make verification, rather than output volume, the story.
summary.zh: OpenAI 10月7日更新记录因符号错误撤回3篇关联稿件，现列719篇。公开修订把故事焦点从产量拉回验证。

title.en: Jared Isaacman wants a Moon reactor by 2030. Can NASA keep the lights on?
title.zh: 艾萨克曼要在2030年备好月球反应堆：漫长黑夜，靠什么扛？

summary.en: NASA and the Energy Department signed a broader nuclear-space cooperation pact on October 8, effective November 1. The 2030 launch-ready lunar reactor and 2028 spacecraft remain planned milestones.
summary.zh: NASA与能源部10月8日签署核能太空合作备忘录，11月1日生效。2030年发射就绪的月球反应堆与2028年飞船仍是目标。
